findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the agreement without cause, leaving you without a matching right. Because work and royalties during the notice period are paid, this is a low risk.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement, at any time, upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice to the other party.
